name: Santa's Night Out

date.source: The fed's own thirteen-part broadcast posting to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy, dated 1 January 1998; this pass reads and structures Parts One and Two (msg_ids TjViX78QXnUJ, eGfacfJQ7I4J).

notes: A World Title tournament's opening round: this pass structures its first two quarterfinals. The remaining eleven parts of the card (a further quarterfinal, undercard matches, the tournament final, and a closing world-title match) are collected but not read, per the holdings bar and the serve-on-contextual-value rule. Dedicated by the fed's own text to the memory of actor Chris Farley.

matches.stipulation: World Title tournament quarterfinal, barbed wire and tables
matches.note: Stevens won with a Shooting Star Press through a table after a lengthy brawl in which MacArthur bodyslammed Stevens' ally Bridget Xavier to the concrete.
Ashida won by sunset flip at 35:37, advancing to face Stevens.
